datasets.details: Limites de l'analyse : Le niveau de désagrégation de l'analyse n'a pas pu systématiquement se faire jusqu'au niveau Zone de Santé.

lineage.description: IPC Acute Malnutrition analysis for Democratic Republic of Congo, classifying malnutrition severity (global and severe acute malnutrition) among children under 5 and pregnant/lactating women by health zone. Data covers two annual periods (July 2024-June 2025 and July 2025-June 2026) with treatment need estimates derived from IPC standardized protocols.
